shortBulletSummary: US-Iran tensions escalated after Iran rejected peace talks, causing Bitcoin to drop below $75,000 amidst a risk-off market mood.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has reached 29, signaling a state of fear among cryptocurrency investors.
Market downturns are being fueled by significant DeFi hacks, such as the Kelp exploit, and warnings regarding altcoin manipulation.
Surging oil prices linked to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are raising inflation fears, which negatively impacts sentiment for risk assets like crypto.
